basic_info.description: Enjoy urban San Francisco living at 1001 17th Street, a boutique collection of 26 residences in the heart of Potrero Hill. Unit 201 is a charming and bright corner/end home overlooking the shared courtyard terrace. Features include an open floor plan with hardwood flooring throughout, high ceilings, Bosch stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, custom window treatments, built-out closets and more. In-unit washer/dryer and 1 car parking complete the home.    1001 17th boasts a prime Potrero Hill location close to Whole Foods, restaurants, shops, fitness centers & more. Easy access to public transit and freeways. Building amenities include a secure lobby with package chest, an attached garage, bike storage, and a shared courtyard terrace complete with fire pit and bbq.    * Some photos have been virtually staged. *
